label: Interposer area and the reticle
subgoals: Add die widths, gaps and margins
Multiply by the height with margins
Divide by the reticle area and round up

label: Wires across the die edge
subgoals: Convert the edge length to micrometres
Divide by the wiring pitch and floor it
Multiply by the routing layer count

label: The bump bottleneck
subgoals: Count bumps along the edge and into the band
Multiply to get the bump capacity
Take the minimum of wires and bumps
